claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Amantadine at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines; its known activity is inhibition of the influenza A M2 proton channel and weak NMDA-receptor antagonism, neither of which produces a cytotoxic killing pattern in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
